programs.title: Eine Million Minuten
programs.desc: Spouses Vera (Karoline Herfurth) and Wolf (Tom Schilling) Küper, parents of Nina (Pola Friedrichs) and Simon (Piet Levi Busch), have difficulty dividing their time between work and household duties.The bond that united them years ago is weakening.Wolf focuses on his professional career, and Vera, confined to her four walls, is fed up with loneliness and having to replace her children's fathers.The family's world is ruined by the daughter's disastrous medical diagnosis.Wolf recalls that the girl's greatest wish was to spend a million minutes solely on pleasure.The Küpers decide to make her dream come true.Together they set off on a lifelong journey that leads through exotic regions of the world.They get to know new places and foreign cultures, and decide what their future will look like.

programs.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
programs.desc: Ten years have passed since a virus wiped out almost the entire human race.The metropolises were deserted and civilization came to an end.Another intelligent species took over the world - genetically modified monkeys.They create their own world with a specific hierarchy.Caesar, a human-raised male who led the apes to revolution, is the leader of the pack.He was one of the few who experienced both evil and good from people.He hadn't seen a human for two years and thought the species was extinct.However, he is wrong.One day it turns out that in the ruins of San Francisco there lives a colony of people immune to the virus, led by a former policeman.Confrontation between both sides is inevitable.

programs.title: In-laws 3
programs.desc: In a recreation center that has already passed its glory days, Wanda (Izabela Kuna) and Tadeusz (Adam Woronowicz) organize their grandson's baptism.At the family celebration, to which they invite Małgorzata (Maja Ostaszewska) and her friend, psychotherapist Grażyna (Magdalena Popławska), the former husband of the first woman, Andrzej (Marcin Dorociński), who comes from Australia with... his son Stanley (Noah Lucewicz), also appears.The atmosphere of the meeting quickly gets out of control, and old conflicts and new romances lead to surprising consequences.The local police must intervene.The third part of the comedy, with a pinch of salt, showing the class struggle.

programs.title: E Poi Si Vede
programs.desc: Three friends compete for an attractive job at the city hall.Federico relies on his father's connections, Fabrizio feels that he is born for this job, and Luca is always lucky.

programs.title: In short
programs.desc: The year 2019, on the threshold of the pandemic.Single woman Ellen (Laura Tonke) spends New Year's Eve with her friends.No one knows that she is having an affair with Sebastian (Ronald Zehrfeld), Eva's (Antje Traue) husband.Rolf (Nicholas Ofczarek) and Dina (Pegah Ferydoni) make a perfect couple, unlike Mareike (Annette Frier) and Adam (Trystan Pütter).Maya (Katia Fellin) wants children, Natalie (Jasmin Shakeri) cannot decide.Max (Henning Flüsloh) comes into Ellen's life and he would love her if she let him.Years pass.The woman attends various types of celebrations, birthday parties and casual social gatherings.He learns about events in his friends' lives.The sense of community unites and allows everyone to return to everyday life with positive energy.Remake of the Danish film "A Long Story Briefly".

programs.title: Happened Schnirch
programs.desc: Brno, the night of May 30-31, 1945. Gerta Schnirch (Barbora Váchová), the daughter of a Nazi and a Czech mother, together with her several-month-old child, is - like almost all Germans - expelled from the city.The exhausting procession, marked by violence and humiliation, later called the death march, ends near the border with Austria.From the temporary camp, Gerta goes to work in the Moravian countryside.She manages to save her own life and that of her daughter.After five years he returns to Brno.No one is waiting for her in the city, but she still can't leave it.She becomes entangled in a vortex of further turbulent changes.A film adaptation of Kateřina Tučková's debut novel, "The Expulsion of Greta Schnirch", touching on the difficult topic of Czech and German guilt, revenge, forgiveness and national identity.
